topic: 限时阅读：匹配、填空与长文耐力
grammarFocus: 指代、词性与平行结构；长句拆解。
title: Timed Reading Under Pressure: Costs and Benefits of Speeded Reading Tests
prompt: In many university courses, students are assessed through timed reading tasks in which they must match headings, complete gaps and sustain attention across long passages within a strict time limit. Some educators argue that such timed formats build the reading stamina and quick decision-making needed in academic and professional life, while others believe they mainly reward speed and penalise careful, reflective readers. To what extent do the advantages of timed reading assessment outweigh its disadvantages? In your answer, discuss both the benefits and the drawbacks of timed reading tasks, and state clearly whether you believe the advantages outweigh the disadvantages overall. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类 Task 2 练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。写作前请仔细阅读题目，明确题目要求你讨论限时阅读评估的优点与缺点，并在结论中清楚表明优点是否总体上大于缺点。建议用约5分钟规划：先确定你的总体立场，再为双方各准备两到三个理由，并思考这些理由如何支持你的最终判断。写作时确保每个主体段落有一个清晰的中心论点，并用解释或假设性例子展开，避免只罗列观点。注意题目要求至少250词，建议控制在270至320词之间，以便充分展开论证而不过度冗长。请合理分配时间，留出3至5分钟检查任务回应是否完整、立场是否贯穿全文、段落之间是否有清晰衔接。
